evidence.response_payload_json: {"schema_version":"4.3-requirement-extraction-v3.1.1","task_type":"requirement_extraction","status":"success","data":{"requirements":[{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C023-S008","start_ref":"C023-S008"},"text":"加密的投标文件开标时须使用加密文件时使用的CA锁在项目规定时间内解密。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C023-S013","start_ref":"C023-S010"},"text":"若供下载的招标文件有更新，投标人必须重新下载招标文件、重新制作投标文件、重新加密投标文件、重新上传投标文件；若招标文件没有更新，投标人必须重新加密投标文件、重新上传投标文件（是否重新制作投标文件根据项目实际情况定），否则投标人自行承担投标文件无法解密导致投标无效的后果。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C023-S016","start_ref":"C023-S015"},"text":"实行网上投标，供应商需要在投标文件递交截止时间之前递交投标文件，超过规定时间则无法递交。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C023-S020","start_ref":"C023-S020"},"text":"投标截止时间以后不得上传投标文件。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C023-S026","start_ref":"C023-S026"},"text":"投标截止时间以后不得修改投标文件。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C023-S028","start_ref":"C023-S027"},"text":"从投标截止期至投标人在投标文件中确定的投标有效期之间的这段时间内，投标人不得撤回其投标。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C023-S033","start_ref":"C023-S032"},"text":"如投标文件为加密，则需插入CA锁点击解密，逾期未解密的作无效处理，否则无需解密。"},{"category":"delivery","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C023-S057","start_ref":"C023-S056"},"text":"投标文件初审内容详见《资格性审查表》和《符合性审查表》，投标人若有一条审查不通过则按投标无效处理。"}]},"warnings":[]}
